description: Fault testing only: selects entities as the user would, so selection.changed is raised as for the user's own selection. Refused unless diagnostics are on.

document.description: The part or assembly: its title, its full path, or its file name with the extension (e.g. part.SLDPRT, part.SLDDRW), which picks exactly that document. A name several open documents share is refused with the candidates. The active document when absent.

items.description: References exactly as results gave them, or names (front, top, right, origin, a feature's name; in an assembly, a component's name@component or a component's own name), to select in order.

append.description: Add to the selection instead of replacing it. Default false.
